[A10] A paragraph resumed inside a list item could be mistaken for a top-level paragraph, causing generated navigation to expose a heading hidden by an HTML block. This change tracks the item's content column and paragraph context, and documents the remaining container-heading omissions.

## Contents

- [Status](#status)
- [Linked Issue / roles](#linked-issue--roles)
- [Description](#description)
- [Authoritative references](#authoritative-references)
- [How to get into the same state](#how-to-get-into-the-same-state)
- [How to validate](#how-to-validate)
- [Known limitations / out of scope](#known-limitations--out-of-scope)
- [Definition of Done](#definition-of-done)

## Status

Head 65df1df50a80cd5f540a93d8f0cfabc97da3da75, tree da06c8609b7a574e3df121fbcb8a1fc8f207dcb7, branch 437-container-paragraph-scopes -> dev, based on 88e9276b2a220c716f64a843f7e1eb8f9265e896. The exact local bar is recorded in the validation comment. Trusted act, hosted checks and independent reviews remain separate requirements.

## Linked Issue / roles

Closes #437
Relates to #413 and #440

Executor A168 (Codex); manager A10. Independent cleared-context internal reviewer R237 (Codex), external reviewer R238 (Opus).

## Description

The Markdown walk retains an outer list item's content column and empty/nonempty state across paragraph boundaries. A resumed item paragraph stays within that context, so a following top-level type-7 HTML tag cannot invent the hidden heading. Existing boundary classifications and the prior #507 closer controls remain.

The change adds 47 TOC cases, including five explicit omission cases, and 42 real-Git em-dash controls. The exemption and provenance decision functions are unchanged; no function or module budget is widened. The selected limitation path documents five setext/container heading shapes without adding their anchors.

## Authoritative references

- [Issue #437 and settled scope](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/issues/437#issuecomment-5775771538).
- CONTRIBUTING section 6.1; CODE_QUALITY rule 12; REQUIREMENTS verification gates.
- CommonMark 0.31.2 sections 4.2-4.4, 4.6 and 5.2-5.3, and GFM footnote behavior.
- [Exact reconstructed renderer fixtures](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/issues/437#issuecomment-5775985191), [focused evidence](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/issues/437#issuecomment-5776027743), and [immutable author packet](https://github.com/kebag-logic/milan-fpga/tree/1dc9d95bbc9cb6cf48bb30ce59d0dc2b587a8c92/review-evidence/437-r1/author).

## How to get into the same state

    git fetch origin 437-container-paragraph-scopes dev
    git checkout 65df1df50a80cd5f540a93d8f0cfabc97da3da75
    git submodule update --init third_party/verilog-axis protocol-processor gptp-processor

Use the documented toolchain in docs/testing/RUNNING_TESTS.md.

## How to validate

    python3 scripts/gen_toc.py --selftest
    python3 scripts/gen_toc.py --check
    python3 scripts/gen_toc.py --verify-anchors
    python3 scripts/check_em_dash.py --selftest
    python3 scripts/check_em_dash.py --base 88e9276b2a220c716f64a843f7e1eb8f9265e896
    python3 scripts/docs_check.py
    python3 scripts/check_py_idiom.py

Expected: 754 TOC and 99 em-dash arms pass, generated navigation and existing fragments agree, and documentation/idiom gates pass. The author packet reproduces the renderer, corpus, refusal and mutation controls: 17 bounded mutants fail both shipped self-tests; both 163-page corpus comparisons are unchanged; all 707 prior arm inputs retain their classifications. Complete manager commands and raw results are posted separately.

## Known limitations / out of scope

The eleven historical escape shapes are reconstructed from the original public descriptions. Their exact new request/response bytes are published; the unavailable original JSON/HTML archive identity is not claimed. This evidence limit remains visible to independent review.

This remains a bounded Markdown walk, not a complete recursive container parser. The selected five container/setext forms stay omitted as documented. No exemption/provenance policy, product RTL, firmware, workflow or PP/gPTP processor pin changes. No physical evidence is claimed.

## Definition of Done

- [x] Scoped implementation and focused controls are complete.
- [x] Authoritative documentation names the retained omissions.
- [ ] Full local and current-candidate bars pass.
- [ ] Self-test evidence is posted on this PR.
- [ ] Trusted act and required hosted contexts pass on the final head.
- [ ] Two independent positive reviews and reviewer-owned clean five-lens coverage.
- [ ] No blocking/minor finding or review round remains.
- [ ] Actual merge, post-merge containment, hosted completion and Closed/Done verified.
